limitations: Pinned CDB metadata and the dated TCG application restriction snapshot are technical inputs, not new official rule authentication.
Starting GYs and fields are explicit declarations; Extra revival eligibility is tested using actual registered Fusion/Synchro/Link actions and battle destruction.
Only registered reviewed revival profiles and bounded response packets are covered; arbitrary card text, general priority, Xyz/Pendulum and unknown mandatory triggers are excluded.
Competitive scoring remains provisional by user request; diagnostic decks are not tournament evidence.
